requirements.title: SAME_TYPE_AS compares extensible dynamic types exactly
requirements.definition: With A or B of extensible dynamic type, the result is true exactly for the same dynamic type and false for different dynamic types; 7.3.2.3 supplies declared-type dynamic types for disassociated CLASS(t) pointers and unallocated CLASS(t) allocatables.

pending.SAME_TYPE_AS-same-extensible-dynamic-typ: Allocate two CLASS(base) objects with dynamic type base, initialize result to .false., assert SAME_TYPE_AS is true, and mutate one allocation to the extension type.
pending.SAME_TYPE_AS-different-extensible-dynami: Allocate one CLASS(base) object as base and one as an extension, initialize result to .true., assert SAME_TYPE_AS is false, and mutate both allocations to the same dynamic type.
pending.SAME_TYPE_AS-disassociated-class-pointer: From 7.3.2.3 p3 and p5, declare CLASS(base), POINTER :: p=>NULL() so association status is defined and dynamic type is declared type base; compare p with a TYPE(base) object, initialize result to .false., and assert SAME_TYPE_AS is true.

From 7.3.2.3 p3 and p5, use the same disassociated CLASS(base) pointer p and compare it with a TYPE(extension) object; initialize result to .true. and assert SAME_TYPE_AS is false, proving declared type base is used rather than an extension.
pending.SAME_TYPE_AS-unallocated-class-allocatab: From 7.3.2.3 p3 and p5, declare an unallocated CLASS(base), ALLOCATABLE variable a so dynamic type is declared type base; compare a with a TYPE(base) object, initialize result to .false., and assert SAME_TYPE_AS is true.
From 7.3.2.3 p3 and p5, use the same unallocated CLASS(base) allocatable a and compare it with a TYPE(extension) object; initialize result to .true. and assert SAME_TYPE_AS is false.

requirements.title: SAME_TYPE_AS nonextensible results and CLASS(*) no-declared-type cases lack exact truth-value plans
requirements.definition: With neither A nor B having extensible dynamic type, the SAME_TYPE_AS result is processor dependent. For disassociated CLASS(*) pointers or unallocated CLASS(*) allocatables, 7.3.2.3 determines that the entity has no declared type, so the CLASS(t) declared-type oracle is not available.

pending.SAME_TYPE_AS-nonextensible-result-proces: No portable truth-value oracle: p5 makes the result processor dependent for pairs lacking extensible dynamic type. Future fixtures may exercise only the extensible dynamic-type branch for exact true or false results.
pending.SAME_TYPE_AS-unlimited-polymorphic-no-de: For disassociated CLASS(*) pointers or unallocated CLASS(*) allocatables, 7.3.2.3 p4 determines that the entity is not declared to have a type and is not considered to have the same declared type as any other entity; 7.3.2.3 p5 therefore supplies no declared type for a CLASS(t)-style exact comparison. Do not assert a SAME_TYPE_AS truth value for this case.
